title: More Splashes
body:
## Summary
Have more splash texts! That's literally it!
## Preview
Here are some of the splash texts added:


```
Has pixels!
Wait up!
I like trains!
Forgets stuff!
[insert something]
B R E A D
Thanks, Larry!
```


## How To Install
To install a resource pack in Minecraft, you should move the pack folder/.zip file to the "resourcepacks" folder in the Minecraft directory. On Windows, the resource pack folder is usually in
```
[Boot drive name]\Users\[Windows account/Windows local account username]\AppData\Roaming\.minecraft\resourcepacks
```
The boot drive is usually "C:". Once you've downloaded the pack, copy/move it to the resource packs folder and start Minecraft Java Edition. Then, go to "Options" and then "Resource Packs", and choose "More Splashes" and click "Done". That's it. Have fun.
